description: This file defines a Orleans grain class that subscribes to specific streams for batching tests, handles incoming stream items, and reports consumption metrics.

classes.name: BatchingStreamBatchingTestConsumerGrain
classes.description: A Grain class responsible for consuming stream batches and individual stream items for testing stream batching.

methods.name: GetConsumptionReport
methods.description: Returns the current report of consumption metrics.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles subscription to streams and sets up the appropriate callback based on the stream namespace.

methods.name: OnNextBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch of stream items, updating the report and delaying to simulate processing time.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Processes a single stream item, updating the report.
